hooks.text: 组合骰子技能连续突破得分上限
hooks.excerpt: In this game, you combine dice skills to break through one score limit after another, depending on different situations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 共鸣附魔加锻造复制删除改造骰组
hooks.excerpt: Attach suitable resonances to the dice to unleash their stronger powers! Later in each game, you will also unlock the forging workshop, relying on abilities like "copy" and "delete" to further strengthen your control over dice sets.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三百技能骰与二十九套起始牌组
hooks.excerpt: 300 dice with different skills, each appearance bringing you new inspiration. 50 selectable resonances and 7 processing skills allow you to customize your strongest dice as you wish. 29 starter dice sets, each offering a different game experience.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
